exceptions.description: The protocol warmup string mentions initial B and P warmup, but the frozen run source actually warms only P, symmetrically on both backends at depths 3 and 5. Before-pair warmup is P at depth 3 as declared.
exceptions.disposition: Retain the frozen source, settings, openings and all games. No B player participates in this comparison. This is a metadata-description discrepancy, not a model or asymmetric treatment change; disclose it with the results.

exceptions.description: The optional local completion monitor used a relative import one directory too high and exited before starting audits. All 768 games completed successfully under the unchanged frozen runner.
exceptions.disposition: Preserve the original launcher failure log; fix only the ignored local wrapper import and invoke the original frozen audits. No search, statistical source, game, checkpoint or registration changed.

exceptions.description: Initial-run native interrupted opening searches underused their nominal budget as the startup-anchored performance timestamp drifted from receiver realtime. Native 80-ms chronological-quarter mean move times were 78.722, 73.893, 70.597, 68.359 ms; 300-ms means were 298.734, 293.886, 291.511 ms.
exceptions.disposition: Archive every initial result. Replace only the request clock with fresh Date.now (at most 1 ms conservative timestamp quantization). Retain byte-identical C++ and all frozen coefficients. Repeat exactly the same predetermined 768 games only if cumulative four-hour feasibility including 35% contingency and separate 20-minute reporting reserve passes. Do not combine repeats as independent samples.

exceptions.description: The original frozen Student CDF subtraction produced a negative tiny 80-ms p-value (-2.22e-16), a numerical cancellation artifact. Paired confidence bounds and bounded-score inference are unaffected.
exceptions.disposition: Preserve raw initial statistics. Before the corrected repeat, use a tested positive survival-density quadrature for the same Student test and independently verify with Python. No model, confidence procedure, hypothesis, opening or outcome changes.
